title: Memoize a function
hints: Memoize returns a new function that wraps f. Before calling f, it checks a cache of earlier answers.
The cache must belong to one memoized function. Create the map inside Memoize, so it is captured by the closure, and not at package level.
cache := map[int]int{}; return func(n int) int { if v, ok := cache[n]; ok { return v }; v := f(n); cache[n] = v; return v }
